sections.title: 01. Origin
sections.content: JWY PHOTO BOOK is a personal photography archive founded in Seoul, Korea.

books.title: #001 Nogodan
books.curatorNote: Rising to an elevation of 1,507 meters, Nogodan is one of the three major peaks of Jirisan National Park. Renowned for its magnificent sea of clouds and vibrant subalpine wildflower meadows, the peak offers sweeping panoramic views of the surrounding mountain ridges and the Seomjingang River.
